title: Autobalance pinning with latency degradation profiles
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: implement an autonomous region prioritization policy that blends geo-pinning with continuous latency-degradation profiles and capacity-aware weight decay. The goal is to keep customer SLOs stable while minimizing cross-region egress and preventing expensive failovers when capacity noise or short-lived latency spikes occur.

Core idea: instead of binary geo-pin/fallback, maintain per-customer region affinity scores that decay based on observed percentile latency, GPU queue depth, and error budgets. Introduce a latency-degradation profile per region (P50, P95, P99 curves over request size and model family). Use these profiles to compute a soft pin weight that is combined with capacity signals (free gpus, active requests, instance health) to produce a continuous steering weight. Only trigger hard failover or shed decisions when composite health crosses hysteresis thresholds for configurable durations.

Why different: existing steering work focuses on thresholds and discrete pins. This ticket pilots a smooth, tunable approach (autobalance) that reduces thrash during transient noise, lowers unnecessary cross-region traffic, and enables graceful load-shedding to cheaper model variants or cached prefixes when needed.
acceptance_criteria: Affinity engine produces per-customer per-region weights updated every 30s
Latency-degradation profiles are stored in the config service and exposed as JSON schemas
Routing decision respects SLOs: for 99% of requests, chosen region latency <= configured SLO + configured buffer
Circuit-breaker engages only after sustained crossing of hysteresis window (default 60s) and exposes reason in traces
Load-shedding policy falls back to cached prefix or lower-tier model according to customer tier and token budget
End-to-end canary rollout across five customers with telemetry and rollback hooks
Grafana dashboard shows weight evolution, region health metrics, and shedding events for last 24h

runbook: Detection: Alerts fire when composite region health score falls below configured threshold for >60s. Operator steps: (1) open Grafana 'region-steering-overview' and check weight evolution, (2) identify if degradation is latency-driven or capacity-driven, (3) if capacity-driven and burst expected, enable temporary burst-capacity flag, (4) if sustained latency, engage manual pin to secondary region and notify affected customers, (5) if shedding events occur, follow 'cheaper-model' rollback plan and notify SRE oncall. Post-incident: attach traces and weight curves to incident ticket and consider tuning hold_time or decay_rate.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Internal testing: unit + integration + synthetic blast in staging (complete). Phase 1 - Canary: enable for 5 low-risk customers for 48h with increased telemetry (2026-03-12). Phase 2 - Gradual ramp: expand to 50 customers over 7 days with automatic rollback on threshold breaches. Phase 3 - Default opt-in: expose config to console and enable for all non-enterprise customers after 2-week observation window.
test_plan: Unit tests for weight math and decay; integration tests with mock capacity API; chaos tests: packet loss and GPU queue delay; load test: 24h steady-state with periodic spikes to validate no thrash; SLA validation: measure P95/P99 drift vs baseline.
implementation_notes: Key formulas and decisions: (1) weight = base_geo_affinity * exp(-alpha * latency_penalty) * capacity_factor; alpha defaults to 0.12. (2) latency_penalty computed from P95 curve relative to SLO. (3) capacity_factor is sigmoid of normalized free_gpu_slots (configurable inflection). (4) Hysteresis: require crossing threshold for 3 successive windows (default window=20s) before hard actions. (5) Circuit-breaker reasons surfaced to tracing 'steering.reason' tag.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: incorrect alpha tuning causes over-eager failovers. Mitigation: start with conservative alpha and A/B test. Risk: telemetry blind spots hide capacity issues. Mitigation: add synthetic probes that emulate customer request mix. Risk: customers with strict geo requirements may be affected. Mitigation: support per-tenant hard-pin and enterprise opt-out.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus reviews on: (a) decay math correctness, (b) performance of affinity engine at 100k tenants, (c) traceability of reasons in spans, (d) safety of hysteresis parameters. Also validate that release 'runtime-1.22' ops hooks are present.
